::: {.lead}
Two thermally decoupled model zones
:::

The model distinguishes an **actively cooled zone and a zone without active cooling, thermally decoupled from one another**.[^rc-modell]

Solar gains enter through windows; internal heat gains arise inside the room. Transmission and ventilation are shown as examples of heat removal; their actual direction depends on conditions.

## Entering building-physics inputs {#excel-bauphysik}

Describe the areas and properties of components that determine the district's heat exchange. The interactive view helps distinguish the thermal boundary from component assignment.

::: {.excel-operation}
**Where in PEExcel?** Open [🧱]{.excel-menu .darkred} **Bauphysik** (building physics).
:::

### Inputs on the building-physics sheet

| Input group | Assignment |
|---|---|
| Opaque thermal envelope | External walls excluding windows, roof or uppermost thermal ceiling, basement ceiling/ground-contact floor; areas and U-values |
| Translucent components | Window areas including frames by orientation, U-values and g-values |
| Thermal bridges / airtightness | Allowance and n50 assumption based on project information |
| Shading / movable solar protection | Reduction factors and control assumptions; distinguish suggested values from values actually applied |
| Effective thermal mass | Construction type and effective heat capacity |

Apply [presets](presets.qmd), then check project-specific areas and properties. After calculation, check the heat balance on the [results sheet](results.qmd#waermebilanz).

::: {.declaration-note}
**Declaration:** Internal heat gains and user electricity can in principle be modelled freely. For a declaration, use the designated values of the tool version in use.
:::

The section view uses a schematic reference building.

[^rc-modell]: Each zone uses a simplified thermal RC model with one thermal mass: heat capacity C represents storage, and resistances R represent heat exchange. No heat exchange is assumed between the two zones. The model supports energy concept assessment; it is not a detailed multi-zone room model. Explanation by the project team; [PEExcel training, slides 11–14](../downloads/schulung.pdf) (German).
